reviewed_contracts.contract: Connected existing generation order and publication
reviewed_contracts.evidence: Workflow first exports the existing managed-hazel envelope using a step-scoped update flag, then invokes the existing fixture generator separately for garden-review, massive-city and compound-review. The actual selector consumes one --fixture argument. Actual garden and compound receivers both compile a city before selecting their sites. The existing art-demo city example then writes prepared city layout and furniture; those writes are sequential, so successful completion and preserving the pair remain required. Revision is recorded before exports and all generated output is uploaded even on failure. Docs explicitly require successful required export steps and warn that failure artifacts can contain partial or stale output.

reviewed_contracts.contract: Cloud conditional regeneration remains governed by the existing oracle
reviewed_contracts.evidence: The existing exact nonignored identity/completeness case executes before any cloud exporter. A success must contain one passed case. The failure branch must contain the exact one-failed-case libtest summary before the existing ignored exporter may run; compile failures and zero-case results do not satisfy that gate. Export and subsequent rerun both require the exact one-passed-case summary. Actual scenery receiver validates the two Oak/City digest-pixel pairs, expected byte population and nonempty pixels. Its prepare_input captures the raw input digest before prepared-city curation, which is retained rather than silently changed by this workflow.

reviewed_contracts.contract: Focused native portability evidence complements normal Linux quality
reviewed_contracts.evidence: The ordinary-mode Windows job checks the exact selected revision, removes the envelope update flag, exposes the bundled rust-lld.exe directory required by the existing Windows target configuration, and runs five existing filters. Actual source contains 2 shrub cases, 1 envelope case, 5 leaf cases, 1 shoot sampling case and 1 prepared impostor case. Per-filter logs must each contain exactly one successful libtest result with a positive passed population. All five cargo pipelines fail on process errors. No new Rust test, case, assertion, helper, platform-specific snapshot or relaxed tolerance is introduced. The unchanged normal Linux quality body remains the normal acceptance path; export mode does not substitute for it.

reviewed_contracts.contract: Documentation matches source and evidence limits
reviewed_contracts.evidence: Owning garden guide describes connected outputs, source revision matching, required successful steps, preserving pairs, importing only changed generated assets and rerunning normal quality on the final committed revision. ART_DEMO links that guide and describes separate Linux/Windows checks. These are contributor guides, with no root README expansion, wiki prose, in-world UI or speculative runtime acceptance claim. Existing Rust cache additions do not alter quality commands or exemptions.
